prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Full-screen 16:9 raster background for a 2D science-fiction game's interactive galactic navigation map.

Create an entirely original top-down spiral galaxy that naturally reads as several navigable sectors and distinct stellar regions; do not reproduce any existing game's interface, composition, labels, symbols, or assets.
Deep near-black outer space, controlled star field, branching arms and stellar clusters separated by readable dark dust lanes.

One complete galaxy disk with a compact luminous core that retains texture and is not blown out; include bright nebular knots, sparse frontier pockets, dark rifts, and star-cluster islands for future UI markers.
Premium original science-fiction concept art with an ominous extraterrestrial hunting mood and no recognizable franchise iconography.
Wide landscape composition with the galaxy inside the frame and clean negative-space pockets around the rim and between major arms; avoid any rigid grid or table-like arrangement.
Palette: black and charcoal space, copper, amber and gold stellar arms, restrained cyan and toxic teal-green accents, occasional muted rust-red dust.

No text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, interface, HUD, boundary lines, connecting lines, crosshairs, icons, orbit rings, close-up planets, spacecraft, characters, weapons, targeting lasers, panels, checkerboards or grids.
